changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS disputes ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY, rental_id UUID NOT NULL, client_id UUID, agency_id UUID, contested_amount NUMERIC(19,2), reason TEXT NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'OPEN', admin_note TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), resolved_at TIMESTAMPTZ ); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_disputes_status ON disputes(status); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_disputes_agency ON disputes(agency_id);
